evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and updates CI workflow alongside macOS compiler requirements.
rationale: Updates minimum supported Xcode CLT to 26.3 following macOS 14 EOL and enables future language updates. The author notes macOS Sonoma 14 reached EOL in August 2026, and updating CLT 'will allow to use C++20 CTAD and also allow switching the project to C++23.' While a worthwhile toolchain maintenance step, it is reasonably deferrable on its own.
